sections.text:
Nanodrones require accurate, real-time state estimation under severe sensing and computational constraints. We present TinyCVIO, a visual-inertial odometry system that co-designs miniature sensing, visual processing, and estimation for a commodity dual-core microcontroller with 520 kB SRAM.

Lightweight LED constellations provide known geometry without surveyed positions or yaw angles, assuming placement on a common level plane.

A streaming visual frontend tracks LED observations from a millimeter-scale camera at 29.2 FPS, while a rigid-board measurement model retains inter-LED constraints and streaming QR bounds estimation workspace for a fixed filter-state size.

Across 19 hand-held hardware-in-the-loop datasets, the rigid-board model reduces mean absolute trajectory error by 27% relative to planar points.

The complete system runs onboard a Crazyflie across nine flights at three speeds, achieving 3.5-3.7 cm mean absolute trajectory error and 0.50-0.60% relative pose error over 10 m segments, with mean estimate latency of 15.7-16.3 ms.

summary.en: The paper targets real-time state estimation for nanodrones under severe sensing and compute constraints. TinyCVIO co-designs miniature vision, inertial sensing, and estimation for a dual-core microcontroller. LED constellations provide known geometry under a common-level-plane assumption; a streaming frontend tracks LEDs, a rigid-board model preserves inter-point constraints, and streaming QR bounds workspace. Across 19 handheld hardware-in-the-loop datasets, the model lowers mean absolute trajectory error by 27% versus planar points. Nine Crazyflie flights also report centimeter-scale error and millisecond latency.
summary.zh: 论文针对纳米无人机在传感与算力极受限条件下仍需实时精确定位的问题，提出 TinyCVIO，将微型视觉惯性传感、处理和估计协同设计于双核微控制器。LED阵列提供无需测量位置和偏航角的已知几何约束（假定位于同一水平面）；流式视觉前端跟踪LED，并以刚性板模型保留点间约束、用流式QR限制工作空间。19组手持硬件在环数据中，刚性板模型相对平面点降低27%平均绝对轨迹误差；Crazyflie九次飞行也报告了定位误差和延迟。

items.title: TinyCVIO: A Constellation-Aided Visual-Inertial Odometry System for Nanodrones

sections.text:
Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad, instruction-conditioned manipulation behaviors, but their physical execution can remain imprecise during contact-rich interaction. Residual reinforcement learning (RL) can correct such errors while keeping the VLA frozen, but real-robot RL is costly and safety-critical.

We propose VLA Latent-Conditioned RL (VLaRL), which enables residual RL for frozen VLAs to be trained in simulation and deployed on real robots without real-world RL or online adaptation. The key challenge is transferring the learned residual policy despite the visual gap between simulation and reality.

Rather than requiring pixel-level visual correspondence, VLaRL uses the VLA's internal vision-language latent representation to condition residual control and as the sim-to-real transfer interface, and learns a lightweight mapper that transforms simulation-derived latents toward the real latent distribution.

Across four contact-rich manipulation tasks and two VLA backbones, VLaRL improves real-world success in all task-backbone combinations, while controlled ablations demonstrate the importance of both latent conditioning and latent alignment for transferring simulation-trained residual control.

summary.en: The paper addresses imprecise contact-rich VLA execution and the cost and safety risks of real-robot reinforcement learning. VLaRL trains a residual policy in simulation while keeping the VLA frozen, then deploys without real-world RL or online adaptation. To bridge visual domain shift, it conditions residual control on the VLA's internal vision-language latents and learns a lightweight mapper toward the real latent distribution. Across four contact-rich tasks and two VLA backbones, the authors report improved real-world success in every combination; ablations support both latent conditioning and alignment.
summary.zh: 论文针对VLA在接触丰富操作中执行不够精确、真实机器人强化学习成本高且有安全风险的问题，提出 VLaRL：冻结VLA，仅训练残差强化学习策略，并在仿真训练后直接迁移真实机器人，不进行真实环境RL或在线适配。为应对视觉域差异，方法使用VLA内部视觉语言潜表示作为残差策略条件及迁移接口，并学习轻量映射器对齐仿真和真实潜分布。作者在四项接触操作任务、两种VLA骨干上均报告真实世界成功率改善，消融实验支持潜表示条件与对齐的作用。

items.title: VLaRL: Augmenting Vision-Language-Action Models with Simulation-Trained Latent-Conditioned Residual RL

sections.text:
Building a robotic manipulation system requires connecting perception, planning, and control through carefully designed representations and interfaces. VLM code generation offers a way to automate this construction, but independently generated components may operate on incompatible geometric and task-level information.

We present Representation-guided Integration of VLM-generated Executable Task programs (RIVET), a framework for generating complete manipulation systems around a shared object-centric representation.

The representation combines per-object 6D poses, which preserve the metric information required for action grounding, with a relation graph that exposes the task-level structure required for planning.

Guided by this representation, a VLM generates cooperating perception, rendering, relation-inference, and planning programs, each combining task-specific computation with available packages where useful. The resulting programs are authored once for a manipulation domain and reused on unseen start and goal configurations without code regeneration.

We evaluate RIVET on cube stacking, tangram rearrangement, and three-dimensional assembly in simulation and on a physical robot, where we achieve 83% overall success rate in the real world by reusing offline-generated systems.

Our results demonstrate that representation-guided program generation can adapt a common manipulation framework to tasks with different geometric, relational, and sequential requirements.

summary.en: The paper addresses incompatibilities among separately generated perception, planning, and control programs. RIVET guides VLM-generated system components with a shared object-centric representation containing metric 6D poses and a task relation graph. It generates cooperating perception, rendering, relation-inference, and planning programs that can be reused within a manipulation domain on unseen start and goal configurations without code regeneration. Evaluation on simulated and physical cube stacking, tangram rearrangement, and 3D assembly reports 83% overall success on the real robot.
summary.zh: 论文针对视觉语言模型分别生成的感知、规划和控制程序可能使用不兼容几何及任务信息的问题，提出 RIVET，以共享对象中心表征指导生成与集成。该表征结合对象六自由度位姿和揭示任务结构的关系图；模型据此生成协作的感知、渲染、关系推断与规划程序，并可在同一操作领域复用于未见起始和目标配置，无需重新生成代码。作者在仿真及真实机器人上的方块堆叠、七巧板重排和三维装配评估中报告，真实场景总体成功率为83%。

items.title: Representation-Guided Generation and Integration of Executable Programs for Robot Manipulation

sections.text:
Collision detection is critical for ensuring the safety of planned paths. However, it imposes a non-negligible computational burden on motion planners, motivating extensive studies on collision-detection acceleration.

In commonly used phase-based collision-detection methods, the broad phase employs hierarchical structures to rapidly discard object pairs that are clearly collision-free, while the subsequent narrow phase performs detailed collision checks on the remaining object pairs whose collision status cannot be determined by the broad phase.

Although these methods effectively reduce the number of detailed checks through broad-phase pruning, the narrow phase is usually executed in the default order returned by the broad phase, with little explicit optimization of the check order.

This leaves room for further acceleration, especially in cluttered environments where many object pairs may remain after the broad phase and the narrow phase can account for a significant portion of the total detection time.

In this work, we propose a learning-based method to accelerate phase-based collision detection by optimizing the check order in the narrow phase. We first formulate the expected time cost of the narrow phase and derive an optimal check-ordering criterion that minimizes this expectation.

Since the priors required by this criterion are difficult to obtain in advance, we design a hypernetwork-based model to predict collision probabilities, which are then used to approximate the optimal check order.

The resulting order guides the execution of exact mesh checks in the narrow phase, thereby reducing detection time without replacing the underlying geometric collision checker.

Simulation results show that our method effectively accelerates phase-based collision detection and improves the efficiency and success rate of sampling-based motion planning, especially in cluttered environments.

summary.en: The paper targets the cost of narrow-phase collision checking, which typically follows a default object-pair order even in cluttered scenes. It derives an ordering criterion minimizing expected narrow-phase time and uses a hypernetwork to predict collision probabilities and approximate that order. Exact mesh checks remain the final test; learning does not replace geometric collision detection. Simulations reportedly accelerate phase-based checking and improve the efficiency and success rate of sampling-based motion planning, especially in clutter, without numerical gains in the abstract.
summary.zh: 论文针对分阶段碰撞检测中窄相位通常沿默认顺序执行精确网格检查、在杂乱环境耗时较高的问题，提出学习优化检查顺序的方法。作者推导最小化窄相位期望时间成本的排序准则，再用超网络预测碰撞概率以近似该顺序；方法仍执行原有精确几何碰撞检测，并不以学习器取代安全检查。仿真结果报告窄相位加速，并提升采样式运动规划效率和成功率，尤其在杂乱环境；摘要未给出具体增幅。

items.title: Learning-Accelerated Narrow-Phase Collision Detection via Check Ordering for Sampling-Based Motion Planning

sections.text:
Humanoid hands require tactile feedback across the whole finger, not just the fingertip, to grasp and manipulate objects properly. Vision and proprioception alone cannot reliably provide this information, particularly when the hand's own fingers occlude the camera's view of the grasp.

We present a low-cost tactile array for a humanoid finger, made from Velostat and conductive tape. The fingertip carries seven contact points including a 2x3 matrix wrapped across its front, left, and right faces, and a separate contact point at the tip. The proximal and middle phalanges each carry a single front-facing contact line.

We measure the sensor's hysteresis and recovery time after release, through repeated loading and press-release tests. We also test a compliant, 3D-printed contact structure with a gap and a bump, inspired by similar designs in prior work, and show it cuts recovery time by 74% compared to a flush-contact baseline.

We then show the sensor can produce distinct activation patterns for different contact geometries (flat, edge, corner) at the fingertip, and that it registers contact across all three phalanges during a grip.

Finally, we discuss the limits of our fabrication changes and point to software-based compensation as a promising way to more directly fix the remaining hysteresis in the future.

summary.en: The paper addresses the lack of whole-finger tactile feedback when a humanoid hand occludes its own grasp from the camera. It presents a low-cost Velostat and conductive-tape array with seven fingertip contacts and additional sensing on the proximal and middle phalanges. Repeated loading tests characterize hysteresis and recovery. A compliant 3D-printed contact structure with a gap and bump reduces recovery time by 74% versus a flush-contact baseline. The sensor distinguishes fingertip contact geometries and registers all three phalanges during a grip, though hysteresis remains.
summary.zh: 论文针对手指自遮挡时视觉和本体感觉难以获知整根手指接触、影响灵巧抓取的问题，制作低成本 Velostat 与导电胶带触觉阵列。指尖布置七个接触点，覆盖前、左、右表面及末端，近端和中段指骨各设一条前向接触线。作者通过重复加载和释放测试迟滞及恢复时间，并测试带间隙和凸点的柔性3D打印接触结构；相较平齐接触基线，恢复时间降低74%。传感器可区分指尖平面、边缘和角点接触，也能在握持时记录三段指骨接触，但剩余迟滞仍待补偿。

items.title: Tactile Sensing Array for Multi-Phalanx Sensing in Humanoid Hands

sections.text:
Geometric filters have recently been introduced to improve the accuracy and consistency of inertial-based integrated navigation systems. Error states were defined through specific group operations, introducing state correlations in error definition, which were lacked in the additive error used by a conventional indirect Kalman filter.

The desirable consistent filtering models can be obtained based on specific geometric errors. For zero-velocity measurements expressed in the reference frame, this paper derives left-error process and measurement models from invariant filtering, two-frame-group filtering, and equivariant filtering.

Importantly, a new group operation is introduced for the left tangent-group equivariant error. The analysis shows that the two-frame-group invariant extended Kalman filter (TFG-IEKF) and the tangent-group equivariant filter (TG-EqF) do not offer a significant consistency advantage over the invariant extended Kalman filter (IEKF).

Experiments with an INS/ZUPT measurement system show that, under small initial attitude errors, the conventional indirect extended Kalman filter (EKF) achieves loop-closure position errors below $0.1\%$ of the traveled distance, while the three geometric filters achieve comparable positioning accuracy.

summary.en: The paper evaluates inertial-navigation zero-velocity filters under different geometric error definitions. For reference-frame zero-velocity measurements, it derives left-error process and measurement models for invariant, two-frame-group, and equivariant filters, and introduces a group operation for a left tangent-group equivariant error. Analysis finds no significant consistency advantage for TFG-IEKF or TG-EqF over IEKF. In INS/ZUPT experiments with small initial attitude errors, conventional indirect EKF loop-closure position error is below 0.1% of distance traveled, while geometric filters achieve comparable positioning accuracy.
summary.zh: 论文比较不同几何误差定义下的惯性导航零速更新滤波器一致性。作者针对参考系表达的零速观测，推导不变滤波、双框架群滤波和等变滤波的左误差过程及观测模型，并为切空间群等变误差引入新的群运算。分析认为双框架群不变EKF及切空间群等变滤波相对不变EKF没有显著一致性优势。INS/ZUPT实验中，在初始姿态误差较小时，传统间接EKF闭环位置误差低于行程的0.1%，三种几何滤波器定位精度与之相当。

items.title: Accuracy Evaluation of INS/ZUPT Filtering Methods Based on Different Geometric Error Definitions

sections.text:
Soft robots have attracted much attention for their safe human-robot interaction and flexibility, but the typical continuum structure and nonlinear material behavior make the kinematics modelling complex, especially in non-static motions.

In this work, we proposed an LSTM-based pressure predictive control (PPC) for the motion control of a vertebraic soft robotic tail and the coordination with a quadruped robot.

The PPC consists of an inverse kinematics (IK) model, a forward kinematics (FK) model and a pressure compensation (P-comp) model, and achieves non-static and quasi-static motion control of the tail. Compared with the IK-only model, the average RMSE of the PPC's simulation trajectories reduces by 69.8%, when executing target trajectories.

In the coordinated motions of the soft tail quadruped, using a prediction data set to train the PPC enables next-moment action prediction and reduces computation time by 60.9%, which enhances the real-time response of the tail to match the quadruped torso's moving rate.

The PPC provides a simple and effective method to model the soft tail for both non-static and quasi-static motion control, and grants the soft tail quadruped with the functionality of interacting with the environment.

summary.en: The paper addresses difficult kinematic modeling and control of a soft continuum tail with nonlinear materials, especially in non-static motion. Its LSTM-based pressure predictive controller combines inverse kinematics, forward kinematics, and pressure compensation for quasi-static and dynamic motion and coordination with a quadruped. Compared with an inverse-kinematics-only model, simulated trajectory RMSE falls by 69.8%. Prediction-data training reduces next-action computation time by 60.9% in coordinated motion; the abstract does not specify real-world manipulation trials.
summary.zh: 论文针对软体连续体尾部材料非线性、动态运动难以建模控制的问题，提出基于LSTM的压力预测控制 PPC，用于椎骨式软尾及其与四足机器人的协调。控制器由逆运动学、正运动学和压力补偿模型构成，支持动态与准静态运动。相较仅用逆运动学模型，作者报告仿真目标轨迹平均RMSE降低69.8%；在软尾四足协同中，预测数据训练使下一时刻动作预测计算时间降低60.9%，有助于跟随躯干运动。验证结果涉及仿真轨迹与协调控制，摘要未说明真实环境操作实验。

items.title: Learning-Based Pressure Predictive Control of a Vertebraic Soft Robotic Tail

sections.text:
Performing complex medical procedures with continuum robots requires careful selection of their geometric design parameters. The robot should have high dexterity in the specific anatomical environment of its procedure. This work presents a design optimization method that considers both dexterity and anatomy.

We introduce the Reachable Volumetric Dexterous Solid Angle (RVDSA) metric as our objective, which measures the ability of a robot's end effector to reach the points in a goal volume from different directions via collision-free paths from a start configuration.

We present a computationally efficient motion planner to compute this objective function for a given robotic design, and we use an asymptotically optimal simulated annealing optimizer to compute an optimized design.

We applied our new method to optimize the design of a bimanual dexterous sheaths robot for performing procedures on cancerous polyps in colon anatomies, achieving a 78% higher RVDSA on average than optimizing for 3D voxel coverage alone.

summary.en: The paper addresses geometric design of continuum surgical robots for dexterous access within procedure-specific anatomy. It introduces Reachable Volumetric Dexterous Solid Angle, measuring collision-free reachability of target-volume points from multiple directions, and combines an efficient planner with asymptotically optimal simulated annealing. Applied to a bimanual dexterous-sheath robot for colon polyp procedures, the optimized design reportedly achieves 78% higher average RVDSA than optimizing 3D voxel coverage alone. This is a design-optimization result, not clinical validation.
summary.zh: 论文针对连续体手术机器人设计需适配具体解剖空间、同时具备灵巧可达性的问题，提出兼顾解剖约束与灵巧度的设计优化方法。作者定义可达体积灵巧立体角 RVDSA，衡量末端从起始构型沿无碰撞路径、从不同方向到达目标体积点的能力；以高效运动规划器计算指标，再用渐近最优模拟退火优化设计。将方法用于结肠息肉手术的双手灵巧鞘管机器人后，作者报告平均RVDSA较仅优化三维体素覆盖高78%；验证为设计优化分析，非临床效果。

items.title: Anatomy-Aware Dexterity-Driven Design Optimization of Surgical Continuum Robots

sections.text:
As robots transition from structured factory settings into homes, they are required to interact with an ever-increasing variety of objects. Many tasks require grasping, and often it is not sufficient to just pick up the target object. Consider a task like "pouring coffee" --- to facilitate the subsequent pouring, the robot should grasp the mug by its handle.

Existing learning-based approaches for grasping either find robust and collision-free grasps that are largely agnostic to the task (e.g., picking up the mug by its rim), or leverage foundation models to propose task-appropriate grasp locations that lack fine-grained physical grounding (e.g., reaching for and missing the handle).

In this work, we bridge these approaches with a real-to-sim-to-real framework.

Based on a single RGB-D observation, we construct a digital twin of the environment, query a large foundation model to propose grasps that align with the object's affordances and task description, and then optimize the proposals to ensure robustness and plausibility before executing the result on the real robot.

Our key insight is that the grasp proposals of the foundation model should be regarded as semantic priors that serve as seeds for local, gradient-free optimization. We leverage Bayesian optimization with Thompson sampling to draw batches of nearby poses, which are subsequently evaluated in parallel under domain-randomized physics rollouts.

The resulting grasp is both task-oriented and physically feasible for execution by the robot arm. Our full zero-shot real-world transfer only takes a few minutes and improves task-oriented grasping success by up to 33% as compared to other state-of-the-art pipelines. Our code is available here: https://github.com/VT-Collab/GraspTwin/

summary.en: The paper bridges task-agnostic robust grasping and semantically appropriate proposals that may lack physical grounding. GraspTwin builds a digital twin from one RGB-D observation, queries a foundation model for affordance- and task-aligned grasp priors, then locally optimizes poses using Bayesian optimization with Thompson sampling and parallel domain-randomized physics rollouts. The selected grasp is executed on a real robot arm. The authors report a few-minute zero-shot real-world transfer and up to 33% higher task-oriented grasp success than other state-of-the-art pipelines.
summary.zh: 论文针对通用抓取虽稳健却不顾任务、基础模型提出的语义抓取又缺乏精细物理可行性的问题，提出真实—仿真—真实的 GraspTwin。系统从单张RGB-D观测构建环境数字孪生，让基础模型按任务和物体可供性提出抓取，再将其作为语义先验，以Thompson采样贝叶斯优化生成邻近姿态，并在域随机化物理仿真中并行评估，最后执行于真实机械臂。作者报告零样本迁移需数分钟，任务导向抓取成功率较先进流程最高提高33%。

items.title: GraspTwin: Zero-Shot Task-Oriented Grasp Optimization via a Digital Twin

sections.text:
Autonomous navigation in previously unseen environments requires effective perception, persistent environmental representation, and collision avoidance while maintaining progress toward a goal. Existing perception-based methods often rely on prior maps or short-horizon observations, limiting their ability to exploit previously observed structure.

We propose a memory-aware multi-sensor navigation framework that integrates LiDAR and RGB perception, online distance-field representation learning, and a stage-adaptive Modulated Control Barrier Function Quadratic Program (MCBF-QP).

The framework persistently represents static infrastructure while tracking dynamic obstacles, enabling the MCBF-QP controller to exploit previously observed geometry for obstacle circumvention and adapt its safety constraints and guidance to local conditions.

Experiments in complex indoor and outdoor environments demonstrate improved navigation efficiency and goal-reaching performance while maintaining collision avoidance in narrow passages and around dynamic obstacles.

summary.en: The paper addresses navigation in unseen environments where prior-map dependence or short observation horizons limit use of previously seen structure. Its framework combines LiDAR and RGB perception, online distance-field representation learning, and a stage-adaptive Modulated Control Barrier Function QP. It persistently models static infrastructure, tracks moving obstacles, and adapts safety constraints and guidance to local conditions. Experiments in complex indoor and outdoor environments reportedly improve efficiency and goal-reaching while maintaining collision avoidance in narrow passages and around dynamic obstacles.
summary.zh: 论文针对未知环境导航依赖先验地图或短时观测、难以利用已见结构的问题，提出结合激光雷达与RGB感知、在线距离场表征学习及阶段自适应控制屏障函数二次规划的框架。系统持续表征静态基础设施并跟踪动态障碍，使控制器能利用先前几何信息绕障，并按局部情形调整安全约束与引导。复杂室内外环境实验报告导航效率和到达目标表现改善，同时在狭窄通道及动态障碍周围保持避碰；摘要未给定量结果或平台详情。

items.title: Memory-Aware Multi-Sensor Perception for Efficient and Safe Navigation in Dynamic Environments

items.intro: arXiv:2609.31383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: End-to-end driving policies are commonly trained through open-loop behavior cloning, yet they must ultimately operate in closed-loop when deployed on a vehicle, creating a fundamental mismatch between training and execution. Beyond the commonly studied effects of covariate shift and causal confusion, we identify a complementary factor for this open-loop/closed-loop gap: waypoint-based supervision and displacement metrics do not ensure that the intermediate trajectory is physically coherent or easy for the controller to track

sections.text:
End-to-end driving policies are commonly trained through open-loop behavior cloning, yet they must ultimately operate in closed-loop when deployed on a vehicle, creating a fundamental mismatch between training and execution.

Beyond the commonly studied effects of covariate shift and causal confusion, we identify a complementary factor for this open-loop/closed-loop gap: waypoint-based supervision and displacement metrics do not ensure that the intermediate trajectory is physically coherent or easy for the controller to track.

We observe that these inconsistencies concentrate primarily at intermediate waypoints, while the predicted endpoint remains comparatively reliable.

Based on this observation, we introduce Endpoint-Constrained Optimization (ECO), a lightweight postprocessing layer that anchors the trajectory to the vehicle's executed history, preserves the policy's predicted endpoint, and reshapes the intermediate waypoints to improve feasibility.

ECO requires no map, privileged simulator state, or additional training, and can be inserted between a broad range of waypoint-emitting policies and their controllers.

Across two closed-loop simulators, it improves the aggregate closed-loop score of all six evaluated generative and regression-based driving policies, and the gains tend to increase with how often the base plans violate motion limits.

On HUGSIM, ECO improves VaVAM from 18.1 to 31.0 HD-Score (+71%), achieving 1st place on the HUGSIM Closed-Loop Driving Challenge. Similarly, on AlpaSim, ECO increases the scene scores of VaVAM and DiffusionDrive by 123% and 22%, respectively.

These results show that for a broad collection of end-to-end driving models, repairing the intermediate geometry of predicted trajectories without changing the policy's predicted endpoint can substantially improve closed-loop performance.

summary.en: The paper addresses the mismatch between open-loop behavior-cloning training and closed-loop driving, noting that intermediate waypoints may be physically incoherent even when the endpoint is reliable. Endpoint-Constrained Optimization post-processes trajectories by anchoring them to executed history, preserving the predicted endpoint, and reshaping intermediate points, with no map, privileged state, or additional training. Across six policies in two closed-loop simulators it reportedly improves aggregate scores; VaVAM gains 71% on HUGSIM, while VaVAM and DiffusionDrive gain 123% and 22% on AlpaSim.
summary.zh: 论文指出端到端驾驶策略通常用开环模仿学习训练、却需闭环执行，且中间航点即使位移误差较小也可能物理不连贯或难以跟踪。作者观察到预测终点相对可靠，提出无需训练、地图或特权状态的端点约束优化 ECO：锚定车辆已执行历史、保留策略终点并重塑中间轨迹。在两个闭环仿真器的六种策略上均改善综合得分；作者报告 HUGSIM 中 VaVAM 得分提升71%，AlpaSim中 VaVAM 和 DiffusionDrive场景分数分别提升123%和22%。

items.title: Guiding End-to-End Driving Models with Endpoint-Constrained Trajectory Optimization

We investigate the topological structure of the optimal actuation landscape for fully-actuated N-rotor aerial vehicles.

By formulating the design problem on the 2N-dimensional product manifold of projective lines (RP^2)^N and minimizing a rotation-invariant Log-Volume isotropy metric, we map how optimal rotor orientations evolve across diverse polyhedral chassis. The results establish that global optimality is strictly bounded by geometric symmetry.

While irregular chassis yield discrete, isolated optimal configurations, regular geometries induce a structural phase transition: the optimal space initially collapses onto an N-dimensional tangent torus, then systematically reduces to continuous configurations governed by affine phase coordination.

summary.en: The paper studies the topology of optimal actuation layouts for fully actuated N-rotor aerial vehicles. It formulates rotor orientations on a product manifold of projective lines and minimizes a rotation-invariant log-volume isotropy metric. The analysis relates global optima to chassis symmetry and describes dimension collapse for regular geometries as the proposed N-5 Scaling Law: for stated rotor-count regimes, optima form closed one-dimensional loops or backbones within higher-dimensional flat manifolds. The abstract truncates during its final polygon-isomorphism claim, so that conclusion is incomplete; the work is theoretical.
summary.zh: 论文研究全驱动N旋翼飞行器最优作动布局的拓扑结构，目标是在不同多面体机架上理解旋翼方向的全局最优解。作者将设计置于射影直线乘积流形，并最小化旋转不变的对数体积各向同性指标；分析指出全局最优性受几何对称性约束，规则几何发生维数收缩，并提出“N-5缩放律”，描述特定旋翼数下最优解由闭合曲线扩展为高维平坦最优流形中的骨干。摘要末尾在多边形同构论述处截断，故该部分结论不完整；文中主要是理论拓扑分析。

items.title: The N-5 Scaling Law: Topological Dimensionality Reduction in the Optimal Design of Fully-actuated Multirotors

sections.text:
Task-agnostic assistive exoskeleton control based on human intention offers greater flexibility than conventional approaches that rely on predefined tasks or motion patterns. Human joint torque estimation enables task-agnostic assistance by characterizing user actions.

Physics-consistent methods such as Deep Lagrangian Networks (DeLaN) have been applied to estimate the human torques in multi-user settings, but existing approaches cannot adapt to a specific user without retraining, and do not account for intermittent contacts during locomotion.

We propose ExoLaN, a Context-Aware DeLaN for human-exoskeleton interaction that learns the full coupled system dynamics while adapting to changes in interaction context. ExoLaN combines temporal context with partial contact-force measurements from force-sensitive insoles to infer latent dynamics embeddings and estimate generalized contact torques.

On seven unseen users performing 21 unseen tasks, ExoLaN reduces torque estimation MSE by 7% compared to a black-box baseline.

Beyond inverse dynamics, ExoLaN serves as a unified model that also enables accurate forward prediction: training with a multi-step prediction loss reduces acceleration MSE by 59% and long-horizon position and velocity errors by 60% and 93%, respectively, compared with a single-step loss.

Moreover, the learned latent context captures task information without explicit task labels, making it a promising signal for task-aware assistive control.

summary.en: The paper addresses physics-consistent exoskeleton dynamics models that cannot adapt to new users without retraining and ignore intermittent contact. ExoLaN combines temporal context with partial contact-force measurements from force-sensitive insoles to infer latent dynamics and estimate generalized contact torques. On seven unseen users performing 21 unseen tasks, torque-estimation MSE is reported 7% lower than a black-box baseline. Multi-step training versus single-step loss reduces acceleration MSE by 59% and long-horizon position and velocity errors by 60% and 93%; latent context also captures task information without labels.
summary.zh: 论文针对面向任务无关助力的外骨骼控制需估计人体关节力矩、而既有物理一致模型难适配新用户且忽略步行间歇接触的问题，提出上下文感知动力学模型 ExoLaN。该方法结合时间上下文和力敏鞋垫的部分接触力，推断潜在动力学嵌入并估计广义接触力矩。在七名未见用户执行21项未见任务的评估中，作者报告力矩估计MSE较黑箱基线降低7%。多步预测损失相较单步损失还降低加速度MSE59%、长时位置和速度误差60%及93%；潜变量无需任务标签也捕获任务信息。

items.title: ExoLaN: Physics-Consistent Context-Aware Dynamics Learning for Exoskeletons

For embodied 3D navigation, however, existing data sources face a fundamental trade-off: simulated data can be generated at scale but often suffer from the visual sim-to-real gap, whereas real-world flight data provide realistic observations but are costly to collect. sections.text:
General-purpose robot models increasingly rely on large and diverse datasets. For embodied 3D navigation, however, existing data sources face a fundamental trade-off: simulated data can be generated at scale but often suffer from the visual sim-to-real gap, whereas real-world flight data provide realistic observations but are costly to collect.

This paper studies another direction: the use of high-fidelity visual generative models as scalable data engines for embodied 3D navigation. We introduce NavGen, a text-to-video data generation pipeline that produces diverse vision-language navigation (VLN) episodes across indoor and outdoor scenes.

We also propose a style-diversification method that scales up long-tail data that are difficult and costly to collect. The resulting dataset contains approximately 400K navigation episodes.

We evaluate our dataset against existing UAV navigation datasets across multiple metrics, and find that the model trained on our data generally improves with scale, outperforming those trained on existing datasets. To validate real-world transferability, we deploy the trained model in world-action-model paradigm to real-world flying experiments.

The final model achieves a 75\% success rate across different navigation tasks and environments.

summary.en: The paper addresses the trade-off between scalable simulated navigation data with a visual domain gap and costly real flight data. NavGen uses high-fidelity text-to-video generation to create indoor and outdoor vision-language navigation episodes and diversifies styles to expand difficult long-tail cases, producing approximately 400,000 episodes. Comparisons with existing UAV datasets reportedly show that models generally improve with NavGen data scale and outperform models trained on prior datasets. In real-world flying experiments, the final model achieves 75% success across navigation tasks and environments.
summary.zh: 论文针对具身三维导航数据要么可规模仿真但有视觉域差距、要么真实飞行数据昂贵的问题，提出以高保真视觉生成模型作为数据引擎的 NavGen。该文本到视频流程生成室内外视觉语言导航片段，并通过风格多样化扩展难采集的长尾场景，形成约40万条导航片段。作者比较现有无人机导航数据集，报告使用 NavGen 数据训练的模型总体随数据规模扩大而提升，并超过基于既有数据训练的模型；在真实飞行实验中，最终模型跨任务和环境成功率为75%。

items.title: NavGen: Visual Generative Models as a Scalable Data Engine for Embodied 3D Navigation

items.intro: arXiv:2609.31577v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: General purpose humanoids require locomotion controllers that are multi-skill, perceptive, dynamic, and robust enough to go anywhere humans can. In this work, we present a two layer locomotion architecture: (1) a perceptive flow matching motion generator plans whole body trajectories from raw depth images while a (2) perceptive tracking policy trained with control-guided RL follows these motions. Both policies are trained on a library of terrain consistent motion clips created with dynamically optimized

sections.text:
General purpose humanoids require locomotion controllers that are multi-skill, perceptive, dynamic, and robust enough to go anywhere humans can.

In this work, we present a two layer locomotion architecture: （1） a perceptive flow matching motion generator plans whole body trajectories from raw depth images while a （2） perceptive tracking policy trained with control-guided RL follows these motions.

Both policies are trained on a library of terrain consistent motion clips created with dynamically optimized human data which yields both accurate velocity tracking and terrain consistent references. Our central contribution is a simple yet effective off-policy RL fine tuning loop that improves the motion generator.

A structured search method is used with the generator to gather data for advantage weighted regression. This off-policy loop is much more sample efficient than on-policy residual fine tuning and improves terrain consistency on unseen geometries and skill compositions.

We find that successful terrain traversals increased by up to 25 percentage points and skill selection improved by up to 80 percentage points. By using raw depth images to perceive the environment no odometry or height maps are needed, and outdoor deployment is easy.

With two cameras, the policy can see terrain coming from further away and adjust its velocity regardless of the commanded speed so it can traverse the terrain. A single policy pair enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to walk, run, stand, jump on and off of boxes, and traverse stairs in outdoor environments.

Project page: https://zolkin1.github.io/generate-track-improve/

summary.en: The paper presents a two-layer locomotion architecture for perceptive, multi-skill humanoid control. A flow-matching motion generator plans whole-body trajectories from raw depth images, and a control-guided RL policy tracks them; an off-policy fine-tuning loop improves the generator's terrain consistency and sample efficiency. The authors report up to 25 percentage points more successful terrain traversals and up to 80 points better skill selection. Without odometry or height maps, a policy pair on a Unitree G1 demonstrates walking, running, standing, box jumps, and outdoor stair traversal.
summary.zh: 论文针对通用人形机器人需要从深度视觉感知地形并完成多技能运动的问题，提出两层架构：流匹配运动生成器由原始深度图规划全身轨迹，控制引导的强化学习跟踪策略执行轨迹；再以离策略强化学习微调生成器，提高样本效率及未见地形上的一致性。作者报告地形穿越成功率最高提升25个百分点、技能选择最高提升80个百分点。无需里程计或高度图的策略组合在 Unitree G1 上支持行走、跑步、站立、跳跃及户外楼梯穿越，属实机演示范围。

items.title: Generate, Track, Improve: Perceptive Multi-Skill Humanoid Locomotion with RL-Fine-Tuned Motion Generators

items.intro: arXiv:2606.21372v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models rely on discrete action tokenizers to bridge continuous robot control and autoregressive sequence modeling, yet existing tokenizers often trade off between compression, latency, and downstream performance. We revisit this design through the lens of neural audio codecs - convolutional encoder-decoder architectures with residual vector quantization that serve as the standard front end for audio foundation models. Motivated by their success, we introduce the Neural Action Codec (NAC), which treats short robot

sections.text:
Vision-language-action (VLA) models rely on discrete action tokenizers to bridge continuous robot control and autoregressive sequence modeling, yet existing tokenizers often trade off between compression, latency, and downstream performance.

We revisit this design through the lens of neural audio codecs - convolutional encoder-decoder architectures with residual vector quantization that serve as the standard front end for audio foundation models.

Motivated by their success, we introduce the Neural Action Codec (NAC), which treats short robot action trajectories as multi-channel 1D signals and compresses them using a multi-scale RVQGAN architecture.

With adaptations to the action representation, compression rate, and reconstruction objective, audio-codec-style models can autoencode actions with high fidelity without substantial architectural changes. NAC provides a compact, ordered token space via offset codebooks, enabling standard autoregressive policies to operate over short, structured sequences.

Meanwhile, a Vocos-style decoder with an ISTFT head and adversarial discriminators recovers action trajectories. Across LIBERO-10, RoboMimic, and a suite of real-world manipulation tasks, NAC achieves high reconstruction fidelity and higher average success rates than binning, FAST, and prior VQ-based tokenizers at comparable or better compression rates.

These results demonstrate that repurposed neural audio codecs offer a strong, practical backbone for learned action tokenization in modern VLAs.

summary.en: The paper addresses the trade-off among compression, latency, and control performance in discrete action tokenizers for vision-language-action models. It introduces Neural Action Codec (NAC), which treats short action trajectories as multichannel one-dimensional signals and uses a multiscale residual-quantization architecture to create compact, ordered tokens, with a codec-style decoder reconstructing trajectories. On LIBERO-10, RoboMimic, and real-world manipulation tasks, the authors report high reconstruction fidelity and higher average success than binning, FAST, and prior VQ tokenizers at comparable or better compression rates.
summary.zh: 针对视觉语言动作模型的离散动作编码在压缩、延迟与控制效果间难以兼顾的问题，论文提出神经动作编解码器NAC，将短动作轨迹视为多通道一维信号，以多尺度残差向量量化生成紧凑、有序的动作词元，并用类似音频编解码器的解码结构重建轨迹。在LIBERO-10、RoboMimic及一组真实操作任务中，作者报告其重建保真度较高，且在相近或更优压缩率下，平均成功率高于分箱、FAST及既有向量量化编码器。

items.title: NAC: Neural Action Codec for Vision-Language-Action Models

That number does not show whether the selection was good: a rule can score well by repeatedly using one broadly transferable experience, or poorly because its preferred experience is weak. Since robots increasingly adapt by reuse rather than retraining, a score

sections.text:
Robots that store past experiences must select which one to reuse in a new scene. Most systems select by visual similarity, and most evaluations report only the success of the selected experience.

That number does not show whether the selection was good: a rule can score well by repeatedly using one broadly transferable experience, or poorly because its preferred experience is weak. Since robots increasingly adapt by reuse rather than retraining, a score that describes the library rather than the rule misleads what the field builds next.

We contribute an audit methodology: execute every stored experience in every query scene, over two manipulation tasks, three reuse mechanisms, and libraries of $K=3$, $10$, and $50$.Because every alternative's outcome is known, a score can be traced to per-scene selection or to library quality.

The audited rules select by nearest-neighbor distance in five visual embeddings, from raw pixels to CLIP. （1） One fixed experience, chosen with hindsight, captures 30-58% of the gap between random selection and an oracle; per-scene selection competes for the remaining 0.07-0.15 in success rate. （2） At $K\ge10$, visual rules concentrate on one experience 1.5-3 times more than the oracle does, and their scores then follow that experience's quality. （3） Wherever a rule differs significantly from a shuffle that keeps its selection rates but pairs them with scenes at random, the rule is worse, for every learned image policy. （4） Visual distance predicts well whether a given pair will succeed (AUROC up to 0.96), yet ranks the candidates within one scene no better than chance for four of five embeddings at $K=50$ (AUROC 0.45-0.52).

Exhaustive execution is usually infeasible, so the audit reduces to two cheap reports any study can give: the distribution of selected experiences, and the success of the best single experience in hindsight.

summary.en: Robots often retrieve past experiences by visual similarity, but end-task success alone confounds selection quality with the quality of the experience library. The authors propose an audit that executes every stored experience in every query scene across manipulation tasks, reuse mechanisms, and library sizes. They find that visual rules often over-concentrate on one experience. Although visual distance predicts whether a particular experience-scene pair succeeds, it ranks candidates within a scene near chance for most tested embeddings at larger library size. They recommend reporting selection distributions and hindsight best-single-experience performance.
summary.zh: 机器人复用历史经验时，常按视觉相似度选取案例，但只报告最终成功率无法区分选择规则的质量与经验库本身的强弱。论文提出审计方法，在两类操作任务、三种复用机制及不同库规模下，执行每个经验与每个查询场景的组合。作者发现，视觉规则常过度集中于单一经验；视觉距离虽能预测某对经验与场景能否成功，却在较大经验库中难以为同一场景正确排序候选项。研究据此建议报告被选经验分布和事后最佳单经验表现。

items.title: Beyond End-Task Success: How to Audit Visual Experience Retrieval in Robotics

items.intro: arXiv:2609.30436v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Driving world models learn rich predictive representations of the surrounding environment from visual observations, yet accurate visual prediction does not necessarily translate into effective trajectory planning. We argue that a key bottleneck lies in the mismatch between visual world states and raw geometric trajectories, which may limit the planner's ability to exploit action-relevant semantics encoded by the world model. To address this issue, we propose World-Model Alignment for Latent Trajectories (WALT), which learns

sections.text:
Driving world models learn rich predictive representations of the surrounding environment from visual observations, yet accurate visual prediction does not necessarily translate into effective trajectory planning.

We argue that a key bottleneck lies in the mismatch between visual world states and raw geometric trajectories, which may limit the planner's ability to exploit action-relevant semantics encoded by the world model.

To address this issue, we propose World-Model Alignment for Latent Trajectories (WALT), which learns a compact generative trajectory latent space by transferring information from a frozen pretrained driving world model without modifying the world model itself.

Rather than directly generating raw waypoints, WALT maps them into compact representations through a dual-branch trajectory autoencoder and transfers semantic knowledge from the frozen visual world model into this trajectory space, encouraging the learned action representation to capture scene-level cues relevant to future motion and planning.

Beyond our proposed formulation, we systematically study latent learning based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) and feature alignment following Representation Alignment (REPA) to investigate how trajectory-only representation learning affects downstream planning. We evaluate WALT on the NAVSIM benchmarks.

Relative to the raw-waypoint baseline, WALT improves PDMS from 89.4 to 89.8 on NAVSIMv1 and EPDMS from 87.3 to 87.9 on NAVSIMv2 while reducing trajectory planner FLOPs by 30.5%.These results suggest that preserving world representations while extracting action-relevant information provides an effective interface for world-model-based trajectory planning.

summary.en: Accurate visual prediction in driving world models does not necessarily yield effective trajectory planning. The paper attributes this gap to a mismatch between visual world states and raw geometric trajectories, and proposes WALT. A dual-branch trajectory autoencoder creates compact latent trajectories, while semantic information is transferred from a frozen pretrained driving world model; JEPA- and REPA-style alternatives are also studied. On NAVSIM, the authors report PDMS improving from 89.4 to 89.8 on v1 and EPDMS from 87.3 to 87.9 on v2 versus raw waypoints, with 30.5% fewer planner FLOPs.
summary.zh: 驾驶世界模型虽能预测视觉环境，但这种能力未必转化为有效轨迹规划；论文将瓶颈归因于视觉状态与原始几何轨迹之间的表征差异，并提出WALT。该方法以双分支轨迹自编码器将路点压缩为潜在表示，再从冻结的预训练驾驶世界模型迁移场景语义，同时也研究JEPA和REPA式表征学习。NAVSIM基准上，相比原始路点基线，作者报告NAVSIMv1的PDMS由89.4升至89.8、v2的EPDMS由87.3升至87.9，规划器计算量减少30.5%。

items.title: WALT: Learning World-Model-Aligned Latent Trajectories for Autonomous Driving

items.intro: arXiv:2606.00307v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent works have explored unifying SLAM with geometric foundation models (GFMs). However, directly using GFM predictions for tracking is highly sensitive to model capability and uncertainty, as geometric inaccuracies in the predictions can adversely affect pose estimation. To address this limitation, we propose a decoupled framework that integrates classical feature-based SLAM with GFMs, which achieves higher quality and more consistent dense reconstruction. In brief, we use classical visual SLAM for robust low-latency tracking

sections.text:
Recent works have explored unifying SLAM with geometric foundation models (GFMs).However, directly using GFM predictions for tracking is highly sensitive to model capability and uncertainty, as geometric inaccuracies in the predictions can adversely affect pose estimation.

To address this limitation, we propose a decoupled framework that integrates classical feature-based SLAM with GFMs, which achieves higher quality and more consistent dense reconstruction. In brief, we use classical visual SLAM for robust low-latency tracking and use GFMs exclusively for mapping.

By anchoring mapping to poses produced by the SLAM module and optimizing across depth scales, the proposed design avoids propagating inaccuracies from GFM predictions into pose estimation while imposing geometric constraints on the reconstruction.

The system builds submaps from multiple posed keyframes and enforces scale consistency via lightweight frame and submap scale optimization. It also performs projection-based point cloud fusion within each submap, and updates submaps online to reflect trajectory updates from the feature-based SLAM.

To evaluate tracking and reconstruction of our method, we introduce a loop-rich, building-scale indoor dataset with accurate sensor trajectories and LiDAR ground-truth.

Experiments show that our approach achieves superior trajectory accuracy while improving reconstruction precision by 10%-20% over existing methods, with about 2 cm reconstruction error per 10 m chunk on building-scale dataset. On large-scale outdoor datasets, it attains 10 cm error per 30 m chunk (w.r.t LiDAR ground-truth models).

Code and dataset: https://github.com/ori-drs/ScaRF-SLAM

summary.en: Directly using geometric foundation model predictions for SLAM tracking can propagate geometric errors into pose estimates. ScaRF-SLAM decouples the roles: classical feature-based visual SLAM performs low-latency tracking, while foundation models are used only for mapping. It anchors submaps to SLAM poses, optimizes scale across frames and submaps, fuses point clouds, and updates maps as trajectories change. The authors introduce a building-scale indoor dataset with accurate trajectories and LiDAR ground truth. They report 10–20% better reconstruction precision, about 2 cm error per 10 m indoor chunk, and 10 cm per 30 m outdoors against LiDAR models.
summary.zh: 将几何基础模型直接用于SLAM跟踪时，其深度误差可能传入位姿估计。论文提出ScaRF-SLAM，将经典特征视觉SLAM用于低延迟跟踪、几何基础模型仅用于建图，并通过多关键帧子图、跨尺度优化和点云融合保持尺度一致，在线随轨迹更新子图。作者构建了带精确轨迹与激光雷达真值的楼宇室内数据集。实验报告室内重建精度较既有方法提升10%至20%，每10米片段误差约2厘米；大尺度户外数据上相对激光雷达模型每30米误差约10厘米。

items.title: ScaRF-SLAM: Scale-Consistent Reconstruction with Feed-Forward Models and Classical Visual SLAM

items.intro: arXiv:2609.30428v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation models provide robots with the ability to interpret natural language and reason about environmental context, yet most language-conditioned policies assume that goals are well-specified and that task-relevant information is provided upfront via a prior map. sections.text:
Foundation models provide robots with the ability to interpret natural language and reason about environmental context, yet most language-conditioned policies assume that goals are well-specified and that task-relevant information is provided upfront via a prior map.

Operating in unfamiliar environments with underspecified tasks entails high contextual uncertainty: the robot must jointly infer what constitutes task success, what constitutes relevant information, and where (or whether) that information exists.

We address these limitations via CLUE (Closed-Loop contextual Uncertainty rEsolution), a framework for actively resolving contextual uncertainty given underspecified tasks in natural language. CLUE uses an LLM-derived policy to hypothesize task-relevant concepts and potential plans.

It then uses a language-embedded map, which is constructed online, to ground these hypotheses into actions. The policy sequentially evaluates hypotheses via closed-loop environment interaction and refines its plans as it gathers new information.

We deploy CLUE on a Boston Dynamics Spot across three real indoor and outdoor environments spanning 15 tasks that require object disambiguation, functional inference, and occlusion reasoning. CLUE achieves a success rate within 7 percentage points of an oracle policy and outperforms an LLM-enabled planner without closed-loop feedback by a 4x margin.

Supporting experiments demonstrate that simply building and then querying a language-enriched map is insufficient to resolve complex contextual planning tasks; these approaches achieve roughly one third the success rate of CLUE while requiring over 10x more VLM tokens. We provide additional information at https://zacravichandran.github.io/CLUE.

summary.en: The paper addresses robot tasks with underspecified language goals, unfamiliar environments, and uncertain task-relevant information. CLUE uses an LLM-derived policy to hypothesize relevant concepts and plans, grounds them in an online language-embedded map, and revises them through closed-loop interaction. The authors deploy it on a Boston Dynamics Spot across 15 tasks in three real indoor and outdoor environments, involving object disambiguation, functional inference, and occlusion reasoning. They report success within seven percentage points of an oracle and four times that of an LLM planner without feedback. Map-then-query alternatives achieve roughly one-third the success while using over ten times more VLM tokens.
summary.zh: 面对目标描述不充分、环境陌生且相关信息未知的机器人任务，论文提出CLUE，通过闭环交互主动消解上下文不确定性。其语言模型策略先提出任务相关概念与计划，再利用在线构建的语言嵌入地图将假设落到行动上，并根据交互所得信息逐步修订计划。作者在波士顿动力Spot上，于三个真实室内外环境测试15项涉及物体辨别、功能推断和遮挡推理的任务；报告成功率距预言机策略不到7个百分点，是无闭环反馈语言模型规划器的约4倍。单纯建图再查询的方案成功率约为其三分之一，且VLM词元消耗超过十倍。

items.title: Actively Resolving Contextual Uncertainty for Underspecified Tasks in Natural Language

items.intro: arXiv:2609.30557v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Runtime failure monitors can use a model's internal representations to anticipate failures. We audit this monitoring strategy across two autonomous-driving tasks: online vectorized map generation with LaneSegNet and end-to-end planning with VAD. We find that frame-level errors are predictable at inference in both tasks. For LaneSegNet, a supervised latent probe reaches Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) 0.780 for high Chamfer error; to our knowledge, this is the first post-hoc

sections.text:
Runtime failure monitors can use a model's internal representations to anticipate failures. We audit this monitoring strategy across two autonomous-driving tasks: online vectorized map generation with LaneSegNet and end-to-end planning with VAD. We find that frame-level errors are predictable at inference in both tasks.

For LaneSegNet, a supervised latent probe reaches Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) 0.780 for high Chamfer error; to our knowledge, this is the first post-hoc frame-level failure monitor for online vectorized map generation. For VAD, a supervised planning-latent probe reaches AUROC 0.868 for mean-ADE failure.

Our audit shows that internal access is not necessary for strong failure prediction. A monitor using only LaneSegNet's prediction outputs reaches AUROC 0.825, while for VAD, ego state, driving command, and the planner's predicted trajectory reach 0.924 on the same mean-ADE endpoint.

Adding latent features to either baseline yields no statistically resolved improvement. This observation persists across a broad suite of planning failure endpoints, including endpoints whose labels depend on geometry unavailable to the non-latent baseline.

Thus, predicting failure from an internal representation does not establish that the representation provides useful information beyond observable inputs and outputs. We propose an evaluation protocol for testing the incremental value of latent access and release our per-frame failure endpoint labels.

summary.en: This audit examines runtime failure prediction from internal representations in LaneSegNet online map generation and VAD end-to-end planning. Supervised latent probes achieve AUROCs of 0.780 and 0.868, respectively, but monitors using observable predictions or ego state, commands, and predicted trajectories reach 0.825 and 0.924. Adding latent features yields no statistically resolved improvement over these baselines, including across several planning failure endpoints. The authors conclude that predictive latent access does not establish incremental value beyond observable inputs and outputs, and propose an evaluation protocol with released per-frame failure labels.
summary.zh: 论文审计自动驾驶中用模型内部表征预测运行时失败的做法，覆盖LaneSegNet在线矢量地图生成和VAD端到端规划。监督式潜变量探针分别取得0.780和0.868的AUROC，但仅用可见输出或车辆状态、指令及预测轨迹的监测器也达到0.825和0.924。作者发现，把潜变量加入这些基线未带来统计上可确认的改进，且这一结论延伸到多种规划失败定义。因此，内部表征能预测失败并不意味着它提供了超越输入输出的额外信息；论文提出增量价值评估协议并发布逐帧失败标签。

items.title: Auditing Latent-Space Monitors for Autonomous Driving

However, these sensors have limited close-range coverage, are relatively expensive, and consume significant power. This study investigates whether distributed Time-of-Flight (ToF) sensors can serve as a low-cost alternative to depth cameras for near-field terrain mapping for locomotion and local navigation. We designed a distributed ToF sensing architecture for the ANYbotics ANYmal quadruped, assessed its environment reconstruction accuracy, and

sections.text:
Quadruped robots typically rely on depth cameras and LiDAR sensors to map their local environment. However, these sensors have limited close-range coverage, are relatively expensive, and consume significant power.

This study investigates whether distributed Time-of-Flight (ToF) sensors can serve as a low-cost alternative to depth cameras for near-field terrain mapping for locomotion and local navigation.

We designed a distributed ToF sensing architecture for the ANYbotics ANYmal quadruped, assessed its environment reconstruction accuracy, and benchmarked it against depth cameras for terrain mapping and obstacle avoidance. Distributing these sensors around the robot can also avoid the blind spots of traditional sensors.

Our results show that, despite their low resolution and higher measurement noise, distributed ToF sensors can support reliable perceptual locomotion with centimeter-level local mapping accuracy.

The proposed sensing strategy provides sufficient geometric information for near-field obstacle avoidance and footstep planning, at substantially lower cost, energy consumption, and system complexity than depth cameras.

summary.en: Quadrupeds commonly use depth cameras or LiDAR for local terrain sensing, despite close-range blind spots, cost, and power demands. This study evaluates a distributed Time-of-Flight sensor architecture on an ANYmal quadruped and benchmarks reconstruction, terrain mapping, and obstacle avoidance against depth cameras. The authors report that, despite lower resolution and greater measurement noise, distributed ToF sensors support centimeter-level local mapping and provide sufficient geometry for near-field obstacle avoidance and foothold planning. The abstract characterizes the approach as lower-cost, lower-energy, and less complex, without specifying numerical comparisons.
summary.zh: 四足机器人常用深度相机或激光雷达进行近场地形感知，但这些传感器可能存在近距离盲区，并带来成本、功耗和系统负担。论文在ANYmal上研究分布式飞行时间（ToF）传感器，评估环境重建并与深度相机比较地形测绘和避障能力。作者报告，尽管ToF分辨率较低、噪声较高，仍能实现厘米级局部建图精度，并为近距离避障和落足规划提供足够几何信息。摘要称其成本、能耗和系统复杂度更低，但未给出具体量化对照。

items.title: Quadruped Obstacle Avoidance and Footstep Planning with Distributed Low-cost Time-of-Flight Sensors

items.intro: arXiv:2607.06165v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Omni-directional (360{\deg}) cameras provide embodied agents with a holistic view of their surroundings, making them suited for directional reasoning in tasks such as navigation and object search. Existing Vision Language Models (VLMs) project 360{\deg} observations to 2D equirectangular projection (ERP) images and process them using architectures designed for perspective images. However, they ignore the spherical nature of 360{\deg} observations, where each pixel represents a viewing direction relative to the agent

sections.text:
Omni-directional (360{\deg}) cameras provide embodied agents with a holistic view of their surroundings, making them suited for directional reasoning in tasks such as navigation and object search.

Existing Vision Language Models (VLMs) project 360{\deg} observations to 2D equirectangular projection (ERP) images and process them using architectures designed for perspective images. However, they ignore the spherical nature of 360{\deg} observations, where each pixel represents a viewing direction relative to the agent.

Consequently, their direction estimates often become inconsistent under camera view transformations caused by agent motion. This limitation is particularly critical for map-free navigation, where the agent must continuously estimate the target direction in its egocentric frame.

We propose EAGOR, a training-free, geometry-aware framework for embodied 360{\deg} directional reasoning. Instead of predicting target directions as ERP image coordinates, EAGOR formulates directional reasoning as recursive Bayesian estimation directly on the sphere.

It maintains a continuous belief over target directions and propagates it equivariantly under agent motion without training the backbone VLMs. To achieve this, we introduce the Spherical Harmonic Belief Field (SH-BF), whose spherical harmonic representation provides a globally defined, rotation-aware basis for directional estimation on the spherical manifold.

This formulation eliminates ERP seam discontinuities, latitude distortions, and interpolation errors. We evaluate EAGOR on two benchmark datasets and real-world experiments with a legged robot across directional reasoning tasks.

EAGOR consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving average relative gains of +34.4% and +45.6% on HOS and OSR-Bench, respectively, while improving navigation success by +14.6%, reducing step count by 17.7%, and lowering mean angular error by 24.5%.

summary.en: Projecting 360-degree imagery into two-dimensional equirectangular images ignores spherical geometry and can make direction estimates inconsistent as a robot moves. Training-free EAGOR instead performs recursive Bayesian estimation on the sphere, maintaining a continuous belief over target directions with a rotation-aware spherical harmonic representation. The formulation is designed to avoid projection seams, latitude distortion, and interpolation errors. Across two benchmarks and real-world legged-robot experiments, the authors report average relative gains of 34.4% and 45.6% on HOS and OSR-Bench, 14.6% better navigation success, 17.7% fewer steps, and 24.5% lower mean angular error.
summary.zh: 将全景360度图像投影为二维等距柱状图，会忽略球面几何，导致机器人运动改变视角后方向估计不一致。论文提出无需训练的EAGOR，在球面上以递归贝叶斯估计维护目标方向信念，并用球谐信念场实现随运动等变的更新，避免投影接缝、纬度变形和插值误差。作者在两个基准及四足机器人真实实验中评估方向推理，报告HOS和OSR-Bench平均相对提升34.4%和45.6%，导航成功率提高14.6%，步数减少17.7%，平均角误差降低24.5%。

items.title: EAGOR: Embodied Reasoning in Omni-direction

items.intro: arXiv:2609.05533v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Long-horizon manipulation is partially observable: the information needed to choose the next action may appear only in observations from minutes earlier. Existing memory mechanisms for VLAs, such as retrieval banks, learned compressors and recurrent states, must decide what to keep from the past before knowing what a future decision will require. They were motivated by the assumption that minute-scale history is too large to process directly, which no longer holds for modern VLM

sections.text:
Long-horizon manipulation is partially observable: the information needed to choose the next action may appear only in observations from minutes earlier. Existing memory mechanisms for VLAs, such as retrieval banks, learned compressors and recurrent states, must decide what to keep from the past before knowing what a future decision will require.

They were motivated by the assumption that minute-scale history is too large to process directly, which no longer holds for modern VLM backbones. We propose SimpleMemVLA, a VLA without a dedicated memory module that uses the backbone's native video context directly as memory.

It keeps the sampled history intact in the timestamped video format the backbone was pretrained to process, routes the evidence it finds to a standard flow-matching action head through the hidden states of a generated sub-task, and prefills the history shared by consecutive decisions during action execution, keeping latency close to that of a single-frame VLA.

SimpleMemVLA achieves state-of-the-art results on four memory benchmarks without loss on general-purpose control, and with the same backbone and training setup it outperforms retrieval, compression and recurrent-state methods by a wide margin.

History interventions show that the policy reads specific evidence from its past and follows edited histories without parameter updates, a visual form of in-context learning. On a physical dual-arm robot, it completes two tasks whose decisive evidence disappears before the robot acts. Code available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/SimpleMemVLA

summary.en: In long-horizon manipulation, information needed for an action may appear minutes earlier, while conventional retrieval, compression, and recurrent memories must decide in advance what to retain. SimpleMemVLA uses the backbone's native video context as memory, preserving sampled timestamped history and routing retrieved evidence through a generated subtask to a flow-matching action head. Shared history is prefetched across decisions to keep latency near that of a single-frame policy. The authors report leading results on four memory benchmarks without loss in general control, and show history interventions affect behavior. A physical dual-arm robot completed two tasks whose decisive evidence had disappeared.
summary.zh: 长时程操作中，完成下一步所需证据可能只出现在数分钟前的观察里，而传统检索、压缩或循环状态记忆需预先决定保留什么。SimpleMemVLA不设专用记忆模块，直接把按时间戳采样的历史视频交给视觉语言骨干网络处理，再通过生成子任务的隐状态连接标准流匹配动作头，并预填连续决策共享的历史以控制延迟。作者报告其在四个记忆基准上达到当时最佳表现且一般控制无损；历史干预显示策略会利用特定过往证据。在实体双臂机器人上完成了两项关键证据已消失的任务。

items.title: SimpleMemVLA: A Simple but Effective Native-Video Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models

items.intro: arXiv:2609.22521v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The performance of learned robot visuomotor policies depends heavily on the size and quality of their training data, yet collecting high-quality demonstrations remains costly for robots in the real world. Although large-scale robot and human datasets are increasingly available, embodiment gaps and mismatched action spaces make them difficult to leverage directly. Cross-embodiment transfer, reusing experience from other embodiments to improve learning on a target embodiment, is therefore crucial for scaling robot learning beyond

sections.text:
The performance of learned robot visuomotor policies depends heavily on the size and quality of their training data, yet collecting high-quality demonstrations remains costly for robots in the real world.

Although large-scale robot and human datasets are increasingly available, embodiment gaps and mismatched action spaces make them difficult to leverage directly. Cross-embodiment transfer, reusing experience from other embodiments to improve learning on a target embodiment, is therefore crucial for scaling robot learning beyond per-robot data collection.

In this work, we find that efficient transfer can be achieved by learning from what is shared across embodiments, the visual dynamics of how the world responds to motion, and by effectively exploiting the scarce target-embodiment data at test time.

The proposed framework, called Latent Policy Steering (LPS), implements an embodiment-agnostic pretraining phase, which trains an image-based World Model (WM) with optical flow across diverse embodiments. The resulting WM is finetuned on the target embodiment with robot actions.

It then steers the base policy toward better actions by searching in the WM's latent space for plans that stay close to the finetuning data. LPS is a policy-agnostic framework: it can flexibly accommodate different policies without having to retrain them.

In Robomimic and real-world evaluations, LPS improves the average performance of Diffusion Policy relatively by 16% and 62%, and Pi0.5 by 8% and 14%, with only 50 demonstrations on an unseen target embodiment.

summary.en: Cross-embodiment transfer is hindered by mismatched action spaces and scarce demonstrations for the target robot. Latent Policy Steering (LPS) first trains an embodiment-agnostic image world model with optical flow across diverse embodiments, then fine-tunes it using target-robot actions. At inference, it searches the model's latent space for plans close to fine-tuning data and steers an existing policy, without retraining that policy. In Robomimic and real-world evaluations using 50 demonstrations on an unseen target embodiment, the authors report relative average gains of 16% and 62% for Diffusion Policy and 8% and 14% for Pi0.5.
summary.zh: 跨机器人形态迁移受动作空间不匹配和高质量目标机器人示范稀缺制约。Latent Policy Steering（LPS）先在多种形态数据上以光流训练与形态无关的图像世界模型，再用目标形态动作微调；推理时在模型潜空间搜索贴近微调数据的计划，以引导既有策略选择动作，因此不要求重新训练策略。作者在Robomimic和真实机器人评估中使用未见目标形态的50条示范，报告Diffusion Policy平均相对提升16%和62%，Pi0.5提升8%和14%。这些结果限定于文中所测数据与机器人设置。

items.title: Latent Policy Steering: An Efficient and Flexible Framework for Cross-Embodiment Transfer

However, such pipelines typically retain successful demonstrations while failed rollouts are discarded, even though they expose precisely the off-nominal states from which recovery must be learned. We introduce Kintsugi-VLA, a framework for converting failed rollouts into targeted synthetic recovery data by exploiting exact state restoration and branching in

sections.text:
Simulation enables scalable training of Vision-Language-Action policies by using privileged experts to generate visual demonstrations without requiring every trajectory to be collected through manual teleoperation.

However, such pipelines typically retain successful demonstrations while failed rollouts are discarded, even though they expose precisely the off-nominal states from which recovery must be learned.

We introduce Kintsugi-VLA, a framework for converting failed rollouts into targeted synthetic recovery data by exploiting exact state restoration and branching in simulation.

For a fixed privileged expert, we define interventional recoverability as the probability of completing the original task after the simulator is restored to a given state, estimate it using adaptive Monte Carlo continuations with pointwise Wilson intervals, and characterize its non-monotonic evolution along failed trajectories.

These estimates identify an observed terminal low-recoverability frontier-the point after which measured recoverability remains below a threshold-which is then used to select informative recovery starting states.

In a simulated Franka manipulation task, targeted recovery data yield aggregate SmolVLA recovery success of 34.6\% and 38.4\% under difficulty- and frame-budget matching, respectively, 5.8 and 6.7 percentage points above uniform sampling within the same recovery window.

The same ordering is observed under disturbed end-to-end execution and shifted clutter and physics conditions, while clean-task success decreases from 76.8\% to 74.7\%.Kintsugi-VLA demonstrates how failed simulator rollouts can be transformed from discarded experience into structured recovery-training data through direct interventional measurement.

summary.en: Simulation pipelines often discard failed rollouts, although they contain the off-nominal states from which recovery must be learned. Kintsugi-VLA restores simulator states, branches into continuations, and estimates the probability that a fixed privileged expert can complete the task from each state. It uses an observed low-recoverability frontier to select recovery-data starting points. In a simulated Franka manipulation task, targeted data yield SmolVLA recovery success of 34.6% and 38.4% under difficulty- and frame-budget matching, 5.8 and 6.7 percentage points above uniform sampling. The ordering persists under disturbances and shifted conditions, while clean-task success drops from 76.8% to 74.7%.
summary.zh: 仿真训练流程常丢弃失败轨迹，尽管其中包含策略需要学习恢复的异常状态。Kintsugi-VLA利用仿真器精确恢复状态并分支续跑，针对固定特权专家估计各状态的干预可恢复概率，再以终端低可恢复边界挑选恢复示范起点。作者在模拟Franka操作任务中报告，困难度或帧预算匹配时，SmolVLA恢复成功率分别为34.6%和38.4%，比同一恢复窗口内均匀采样高5.8和6.7个百分点；扰动执行及变化的杂物、物理条件下排序一致，但干净任务成功率从76.8%降至74.7%。证据来自仿真。

items.title: Kintsugi-VLA: Turning Failed Robot Rollouts into Recovery Data through Interventional Recoverability

items.intro: arXiv:2609.30759v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The utility of flexible continuum mechanisms for dexterous navigation is often impaired by their low stiffness, making them ineffective at manipulation in high-force scenarios. To address this challenge, we propose a novel continuum mechanism that achieves both flexible and rigid behavior by antagonistic extension and contraction of a rod-driven continuum helical structure. The helical design combines variable-length capacity with force locking for workspace and stiffness enhancement. In this article, we present the detailed

sections.text:
The utility of flexible continuum mechanisms for dexterous navigation is often impaired by their low stiffness, making them ineffective at manipulation in high-force scenarios.

To address this challenge, we propose a novel continuum mechanism that achieves both flexible and rigid behavior by antagonistic extension and contraction of a rod-driven continuum helical structure. The helical design combines variable-length capacity with force locking for workspace and stiffness enhancement.

In this article, we present the detailed design of the proposed mechanism and characterize its performance through experiments that quantify bending and stiffness. The results demonstrate 180 degree bending range of motion with an average distal positioning error of < 10%.

Further tests demonstrate that force locking directly improves axial stiffness and thus indirectly increases bending stiffness anisotropically, with maximum bending stiffness along load paths with a large axial component.

Tensioning the driving rods provides additional stiffness tunability in the force-locked state, where increasing rod tension proportionally increases bending stiffness with a dimensionless gain of 0.56.

summary.en: Low stiffness limits continuum mechanisms in manipulation tasks requiring substantial force. This paper designs a rod-driven helical continuum mechanism that combines variable length with force locking through antagonistic rod extension and contraction. Experiments characterize its bending range and stiffness. The authors report a 180-degree range of motion and average distal positioning error below 10%. Force locking increases axial stiffness and indirectly raises bending stiffness anisotropically, especially along load paths with a larger axial component. In the locked state, rod tension provides additional stiffness tuning, with a reported dimensionless gain of 0.56. The work characterizes a mechanism rather than validating a complete robotic task.
summary.zh: 柔性连续体机构刚度偏低，限制了其在较大操作力场景中的使用。论文设计一种由杆件驱动的螺旋连续体机构，通过杆件对抗伸缩兼顾可变长度与力锁定，并实验测量弯曲范围及刚度。作者报告机构可弯曲180度，末端定位误差平均小于10%；力锁定直接提高轴向刚度，并使弯曲刚度沿轴向载荷较大的方向增强。锁定状态下增加驱动杆张力可调节弯曲刚度，报告无量纲增益为0.56。结果是机构表征实验，并非完整机器人任务验证。

items.title: Design and Characterization of a Variable-Length Continuum Mechanism with Force Locking

items.intro: arXiv:2609.30264v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Latent world models are typically trained to predict factual transitions, whereas model predictive control (MPC) must compare alternative actions from the same state. A model can therefore achieve low factual prediction error yet poorly distinguish candidate actions. We introduce AD-WM, an action-discriminative joint-embedding world model for counterfactual MPC. AD-WM combines residual latent dynamics with predictor-level action-recovery regularization, using inverse dynamics and a normalized recovery objective motivated by conditional mutual information. Both objectives encourage

sections.text:
Latent world models are typically trained to predict factual transitions, whereas model predictive control (MPC) must compare alternative actions from the same state. A model can therefore achieve low factual prediction error yet poorly distinguish candidate actions.

We introduce AD-WM, an action-discriminative joint-embedding world model for counterfactual MPC. AD-WM combines residual latent dynamics with predictor-level action-recovery regularization, using inverse dynamics and a normalized recovery objective motivated by conditional mutual information.

Both objectives encourage planning transitions to preserve action information; their auxiliary heads are discarded at test time, leaving MPC unchanged. On OGBench-Cube, AD-WM improves hard-start success from 3.7% to 52.0% over a matched LeWM baseline and improves mean success over the reproduced baseline in four of five simulation environments.

Planning diagnostics show that factual prediction error and whole-bank action ranking do not follow the closed-loop success ordering, whereas CEM-aligned elite regret tracks success more closely.

With a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder and matched DROID post-training, AD-WM also improves zero-shot transfer to our Franka setup, increasing basic pick-and-place success from 42.2% to 71.1% without lab-specific adaptation.

These results suggest that world models for planning should preserve action-dependent differences needed for counterfactual selection, rather than optimize factual prediction accuracy alone. More videos and code are available at https://ad-wm.github.io/.

summary.en: World models trained on factual transitions may fail to distinguish alternative actions from the same state, which matters for model-predictive control. AD-WM adds residual latent dynamics and action-recovery regularization to a joint-embedding world model, encouraging planning transitions to preserve action information; auxiliary heads are removed at test time. On simulated OGBench-Cube, hard-start success rises from 3.7% to 52.0% over a matched LeWM baseline, with mean success improved in four of five simulation environments. With a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder and matched DROID post-training, zero-shot basic pick-and-place success on the authors' Franka setup rises from 42.2% to 71.1%.
summary.zh: 世界模型通常拟合已发生的状态转移，但模型预测控制要比较同一状态下不同动作的后果，单靠事实预测误差可能无法区分候选动作。AD-WM在联合嵌入世界模型中加入残差潜在动力学及动作恢复正则，促使规划转移保留动作信息，训练辅助头在测试时移除。在OGBench-Cube模拟中，相较匹配的LeWM基线，困难起点成功率从3.7%升至52.0%，五个模拟环境中四个平均成功率提高；冻结视觉编码器及匹配后训练的Franka零样本迁移中，基础抓放成功率由42.2%升至71.1%。

items.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control

From now on, however, the situation changes thanks to the novel Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) Doppler LiDARs. FMCW Doppler LiDARs not only offer the point range with high resolution but also capture the instant point Doppler velocity through the Doppler effect. In the letter

sections.text:
Conventional LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) or simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) methods heavily rely on geometric features of environments, as LiDARs primarily provide range measurements instead of motion measurements. From now on, however, the situation changes thanks to the novel Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) Doppler LiDARs.

FMCW Doppler LiDARs not only offer the point range with high resolution but also capture the instant point Doppler velocity through the Doppler effect. In the letter, we propose FMCW-LIO, a novel and robust LIO, leveraging intrinsic Doppler measurements from FMCW Doppler LiDARs.

To correctly exploit Doppler velocities, a motion compensation method is designed, and a Doppler-aided observation model is applied for on-manifold state estimation. Then, dynamic points can be effectively removed by the Doppler criteria, deriving more consistent geometric observations.

FMCW-LIO eventually achieves accurate state estimation and static mapping, even in structure-degenerated environments. Extensive experiments in diverse scenes are performed and FMCW-LIO outperforms other algorithms on both accuracy and robustness.

summary.en: Conventional LiDAR-inertial odometry relies heavily on environmental geometry, which can be weak in structurally degenerate scenes. FMCW Doppler LiDAR also measures instantaneous point velocity. The proposed FMCW-LIO adds motion compensation and a Doppler-aided observation model for manifold state estimation, and filters dynamic points using Doppler criteria to obtain more consistent geometric observations. Experiments across diverse scenes are reported. The authors state that the method provides accurate state estimation and static mapping even in degenerate environments and outperforms comparison algorithms in accuracy and robustness; the abstract gives no numerical results.
summary.zh: 传统激光雷达惯性里程计主要依赖环境几何特征，在结构退化场景下可能不稳；调频连续波多普勒激光雷达还能测量点的瞬时多普勒速度。论文提出FMCW-LIO，设计运动补偿并将多普勒速度用于流形状态估计，同时按多普勒准则剔除动态点，以获得更一致的静态几何观测。作者在多种场景进行实验，报告该方法在结构退化环境仍可实现准确状态估计和静态建图，并在精度和鲁棒性方面优于比较算法；摘要没有列出具体数值。

items.title: FMCW-LIO: A Doppler LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
